2027 is Ding Wei, the Yin Fire Goat. Its element is Yin Fire: a candle or a lamp, warm and focused rather than blazing. Its animal is the Goat, warm summer earth: gentle, creative and home-loving. Together they make a year for craft, care and finishing well, not for rushing.

But the year treats every chart differently. Get your free chart at skyandseason.com (link in bio), open Calendar, go to February 2027 and see your own 2027 mark: Good, Steady or Care, for work, money and love.
